data.cultural_impact: The name Asoke holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, immortalizing the ideal of renunciation and self-discipline. It is a name that inspires the quest for inner peace and equips one with the fortitude to forsake worldly gains and material attachments in pursuit of a spiritual path. Moreover, the name signifies the fighting spirit within us to transcend conventional societal norms and embrace a life of simplicity and devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Asoke carries deep spiritual significance as it embodies the essence of renouncing worldly desires to attain a higher level of spiritual enlightenment. It reminds us of the importance of inner peace, self-discipline, and detachment from the material world. By wearing the name, one endeavors to live up to its meaning, striving to lead a virtuous and disciplined life that emphasizes spiritual growth and development. Ultimately, Asoke serves as a constant reminder of the importance of the spiritual journey and the pursuit of a deeper connection with the divine.

historical_references.reference: Aśoka (circa 273-232 BCE) was an Indian emperor, a Maurya Dynasty ruler who ruled nearly all of the Indian subcontinent, from Kashmir in the north to the Kaveri River in the south, and as far east as Bengal and Assam.
historical_references.context: Aśoka was most famous for sending out missionaries and building edicts to promote Buddhism and dharma (righteousness) throughout his empire.

historical_references.reference: The name 'Aśoka' roughly translates to 'painless', 'sorrowless' or 'without sorrow'. There is a legend that Aśoka earned his name when he witnessed the suffering of animals and humans during a war and vowed to become a bodhisattva, a being dedicated to the enlightenment of all sentient beings.
historical_references.context: This legend adds another layer to the historical significance of Aśoka, emphasizing his compassionate nature and his commitment to alleviating suffering.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Asoke' is gaining popularity in modern contexts, particularly in spiritual and minimalist circles. Hinduism being one of the major influences on this name, it is seen as a nod to the rich history and philosophy of this ancient tradition. On Instagram, users share images of temples, deities, and spiritual quotes, often featuring the name 'Asoke' in their captions. On Pinterest, boards dedicated to Hinduism and minimalist design frequently include images and information about 'Asoke'. On YouTube, spiritual and meditation channels sometimes reference 'Asoke' as a symbol of inner peace and enlightenment.
